// Invoke the unchanged pinned Compute SDK FetchVMQuota with synthetic transport.
package quota

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/arm"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/policy"
)

type vmQuotaCredential struct{ t *testing.T }

func (c vmQuotaCredential) GetToken(ctx context.Context, o policy.TokenRequestOptions) (azcore.AccessToken, error) {
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(o.Scopes, []string{"https://management.core.windows.net//.default"}) {
		c.t.Fatal("unexpected synthetic VM quota audience")
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return azcore.AccessToken{}, err
	}
	return azcore.AccessToken{Token: "synthetic-vm-quota-canary", ExpiresOn: time.Now().Add(time.Hour)}, nil
}

type vmQuotaPage struct {
	Status int
	Body   string
}
type vmQuotaCase struct {
	Pages     []vmQuotaPage
	Cancelled bool
}
type vmQuotaResult struct {
	Entries          []UsageEntry
	Risk             []string
	Failed, Panicked bool
	Requests         []string
}
type vmQuotaTransport struct {
	t        *testing.T
	urls     []string
	pages    []vmQuotaPage
	requests []string
}

func (s *vmQuotaTransport) Do(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	if err := r.Context().Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	i := len(s.requests)
	if i >= len(s.urls) || r.URL.String() != s.urls[i] || r.Method != "GET" || r.Body != nil || r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-vm-quota-canary" {
		s.t.Fatal("unexpected synthetic VM quota request", r.Method, r.URL.String())
	}
	s.requests = append(s.requests, r.URL.String())
	p := s.pages[i]
	return &http.Response{StatusCode: p.Status, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}}, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(p.Body)), Request: r}, nil
}

type vmQuotaNetworkTripwire struct{}

func (vmQuotaNetworkTripwire) RoundTrip(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	panic("VM quota capture attempted real network")
}

func TestRegionVMQuotaCapture(t *testing.T) {
	output := os.Getenv("REGION_VM_QUOTA_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
	if output == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing capture output")
	}
	oldTransport, oldClient := http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient
	http.DefaultTransport = vmQuotaNetworkTripwire{}
	http.DefaultClient = &http.Client{Transport: vmQuotaNetworkTripwire{}}
	defer func() { http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient = oldTransport, oldClient }()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("quota.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hash := sha1.Sum(append([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("blob %d\x00", len(raw))), raw...))
	const sourceBlob = "9d98d3d2c221b925fd5b4bbde4ddf78476146491"
	if fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash) != sourceBlob {
		t.Fatal("source VM quota blob changed")
	}
	row := func(name string, current, limit int) string {
		return fmt.Sprintf(`{"name":{"value":%q,"localizedValue":%q},"currentValue":%d,"limit":%d}`, name, name, current, limit)
	}
	envelope := func(rows ...string) string { return `{"value":[` + strings.Join(rows, ",") + `]}` }
	one := func(body string) []vmQuotaPage { return []vmQuotaPage{{200, body}} }
	cases := map[string]vmQuotaCase{
		"arithmetic":      {Pages: one(envelope(row("ExactFamily", 85, 100), row("BelowFamily", 86, 100), row("AtFamily", 100, 100), row("OverFamily", 110, 100), row("NegativeFamily", -5, 100)))},
		"selection":       {Pages: one(envelope(row("standardDSFamily", 10, 100), row("standarddsfamily", 10, 100), row("cores", 10, 100), row("NotFamilySuffix", 10, 100)))},
		"missing-skipped": {Pages: one(`{"value":[{"currentValue":1,"limit":10},{"name":null,"currentValue":1,"limit":10},{"name":{},"currentValue":1,"limit":10},{"name":{"value":"NoLimitFamily"},"currentValue":1},{"name":{"value":"ZeroFamily"},"limit":0},{"name":{"value":"NegativeLimitFamily"},"limit":-1},{"name":{"value":"cores"},"limit":10}]}`)},
		"localized":       {Pages: one(`{"value":[{"name":{"value":"NoLabelFamily"},"currentValue":9,"limit":10},{"name":{"value":"LabelFamily","localizedValue":"VM Label"},"currentValue":9,"limit":10}]}`)},
		"empty":           {Pages: one(envelope())},
		"paged":           {Pages: []vmQuotaPage{{200, ""}, {200, envelope(row("SecondFamily", 9, 10))}}},
		"malformed":       {Pages: one(`{"value":`)},
		"later-malformed": {Pages: []vmQuotaPage{{200, ""}, {200, `{"value":`}}},
		"missing-current": {Pages: one(`{"value":[{"name":{"value":"MissingCurrentFamily"},"limit":10}]}`)},
		"null-item":       {Pages: one(`{"value":[null]}`)},
		"cancelled":       {Pages: one(envelope()), Cancelled: true},
	}
	for _, status := range []int{400, 404, 405, 403} {
		p := vmQuotaPage{status, `{"error":{"code":"SyntheticVMQuotaError","message":"synthetic"}}`}
		cases[fmt.Sprintf("http%d", status)] = vmQuotaCase{Pages: []vmQuotaPage{p}}
		cases[fmt.Sprintf("later-http%d", status)] = vmQuotaCase{Pages: []vmQuotaPage{{200, ""}, p}}
	}
	const subscription = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
	const start = "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/" + subscription + "/providers/Microsoft.Compute/locations/eastus/usages?api-version=2024-11-01"
	results := map[string]vmQuotaResult{}
	for name, fixture := range cases {
		urls := []string{start}
		if len(fixture.Pages) == 2 {
			next := start + "&$skiptoken=synthetic-second"
			urls = append(urls, "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/"+subscription+"/providers/Microsoft.Compute/locations/eastus/usages?%24skiptoken=synthetic-second&api-version=2024-11-01")
			fixture.Pages[0].Body = `{"value":[` + row("FirstFamily", 1, 10) + `],"nextLink":` + fmt.Sprintf("%q", next) + `}`
			cases[name] = fixture
		}
		transport := &vmQuotaTransport{t: t, urls: urls, pages: fixture.Pages, requests: []string{}}
		opts := &arm.ClientOptions{ClientOptions: policy.ClientOptions{Transport: transport, Retry: policy.RetryOptions{MaxRetries: -1}}, DisableRPRegistration: true}
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		if fixture.Cancelled {
			cancel()
		}
		result := vmQuotaResult{}
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if recovered := recover(); recovered != nil {
					result.Panicked = true
				}
			}()
			var e error
			result.Entries, e = FetchVMQuota(ctx, vmQuotaCredential{t}, opts, subscription, "eastus")
			result.Failed = e != nil
		}()
		cancel()
		// These deliberately malformed source fixtures must record a panic, not success.
		if result.Panicked != (name == "missing-current" || name == "null-item") {
			t.Fatal("unexpected source panic outcome", name)
		}
		expected := len(urls)
		if fixture.Cancelled {
			expected = 0
		}
		if len(transport.requests) != expected {
			t.Fatal("incomplete VM source request sequence", name)
		}
		result.Requests = transport.requests
		result.Risk = AtRiskSummaries(result.Entries)
		results[name] = result
	}
	write := func(name string, v any) {
		raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.MkdirAll(output, 0700); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, name), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	write("source-vm-quota-inputs.json", struct {
		SourceBlob, SDKModule string
		DisableRPRegistration bool
		MaxRetries            int
		Cases                 map[string]vmQuotaCase
	}{sourceBlob, "github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/compute/armcompute/v6 v6.4.0", true, -1, cases})
	write("source-vm-quota-outputs.json", results)
}
